leakage_signals: Missing preference weights for proximity versus included breakfast, total cost, evening dining, and refundability.
Ambiguity over whether the under-$190 target applies only to room rate or to mandatory parking and other trip costs.
verdict.rationale: A offers included parking and early included breakfast within budget, but requires a 13-minute drive. B remains under the stated target even after parking and offers the strongest workshop access, but breakfast costs extra. C is the lowest-cost option with included parking and similar driving time, while trading away breakfast for better evening dining. These are materially different but reasonable tradeoffs absent stated priorities. D is less defensible because A is cheaper, refundable, includes the same key amenities, and has a shorter drive.
